correctness.rationale: For every r>=2 all geodesics with three edges have opposite-page endpoints x_i,y_j, i!=j. Their exactly three edge patterns yield necessary and sufficient membership constraints for A, B, C, and optional spine. Disjoint cases give U_r, V_r and the displayed complete polynomial. Inclusion-exclusion yields its value at 1. Cardinality bounds of 2r for the spine-free case and r+3 for spine-containing sets, with their equality conditions, establish the asserted extremizers. Actual independent shortest-path subset enumeration checks all coefficients through r=5; a separate structural enumeration agrees through r=6. Finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The family K_{1,r} Cartesian K_2 is the simplest cyclic tree-prism with a shared spine. It gives a motivated all-subsets geodesic-avoidance enumerator, not a routine parameter substitution: global interactions among horizontal page choices force three distinct forbidden-triple types. The theorem gives a complete polynomial and exact labeled optimum types, with a sharp transition to a unique spine-free extremizer at four pages, plus a three-exponential total-count formula. These facts can support related tree-prism enumerators without asserting any unproved downstream theorem.
